correctness.rationale: Exact covariance-defect recursion is the Bernoulli-weighted sum of symmetric-square branch matrices, not the square of the mean matrix. The characteristic cubic and endpoint substitutions give P(q)<0<P(1), ensuring a second-degree eigenvalue between the affine rate and one. Positivity and a two-step strict covariance contraction prove the whole covariance spectral radius below one; operator-norm/Gelfand bounds and positive definiteness of first-row Gram show the gap is attained in position variance from a valid centered Gaussian start. The standalone verifier checks the identities in exact rational arithmetic.

originality.rationale: The classical first-degree optimal SOR formula is explicitly credited as prior work, not claimed new. The new content is the exact random-coefficient second-chaos cubic, strict gap at classical tuning and observable position-variance witness. Prior Gaussian linear-autoregression/matrix-splitting results tensorize the averaged first-degree matrix, while random Bernoulli switching tensors before averaging, so that prior implication fails. Historic hybrid-overrelaxation priority is a real residual risk.
